::: {#rem-control-in-experiments}

#### Controls in experiments

The word "control" has a second meaning. <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
In an experiment, the investigator assigns the exposure.
The **controls** are the participants who receive the baseline treatment for comparison, such as a placebo [@me4, Chapter 6]. <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
These controls are chosen by assignment, not by outcome.
They are not the [controls](#def-control) of a [case-control study](#def-case-control-study).

:::
